[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and his wives lived in a house which was a short distance away from Concave City on their home planet of [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. During the [[Battle of Cerea|battle]] on [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it was presumably destroyed along with Mundi's family.
